scope: Source and fake-Docker checks only. The manual GitVerse workflow was not dispatched and production was not changed by this evidence run.
controls: workflow_dispatch only, master ref only, production concurrency group v-bootybay-production, exact current HEAD and two distinct 40-character SHA inputs
Pinned SSH host key and non-interactive deploy key; explicit two-browser observer/window input required before SSH

Remote preflight checks exact current release directory and running API/web tags and image IDs, four current/previous local image IDs, unchanged backend/migration tree, Compose and Caddyfile, plus four named Docker volumes; each switched container ID is checked against its local tag ID
Existing deploy-images.sh performs maintenance admission, capacity guard, migration, image switch, proxy validation and health check for previous then current tags
Audit and named-volume identity checks before, between and after switches; EXIT/INT/TERM best-effort current restore only while original volume identity remains available

checks.coverage: Expected pair and fail-closed current tag or image-ID drift, missing previous image, backend/Compose mismatch and missing volume
Previous→current order, three audits, observer window, failure/SIGTERM restore, no automatic restore on volume identity drift, no destructive volume commands in fake trace
Existing injected proxy failure and previous-image return; fixed test fixture to include the current headroom guard
Native release guard suite including new QA-12 tests

checks.command: shellcheck QA-12 scripts and changed release guard scripts

limitations: The current migrator has no schema version table; this entrypoint accepts only exact identical backend/migration source and Compose topology. It does not prove a live schema downgrade or allow a pair with changed backend code.
No two authenticated browser observers, maintenance/admission observation, live image switch, test-content read or real volume preservation has been exercised. QA-12 remains open.

SIGTERM/INT restore is best effort; runner timeout, host failure, SSH disconnection or failed current-image deploy can require operator diagnosis. The workflow must not be treated as autonomous disaster recovery.
